read: Indexes flat to slightly soft into the afternoon (SPY/QQQ +0.1%, IWM -1.0%); energy/refiners pinned at 95-100% of range while airlines and cruise lines slide to day lows (AAL/UAL/DAL/CCL/RCL -0.7 to -1.1% in 30m), the familiar oil-up/fuel-cost pairing, but a web pass found no dated oil or Hormuz headline today, so it is a correlation trade, not a catalyst, and that class has failed. New headlines are mostly re-runs of the morning book (HUBS CEO, NVDA PT cuts, AMD PT raise) or already priced (GPN deal abandoned, -9.5% since open; skipped at the 12:04 flash). No new trade. The 12:00 NVDA short stays open: NVDA is 92% of range, not at a new high, and the DOJ report hasn't been walked back; the PT cuts keep coming.
